description: Hand-written: the survival.* rows' own contract (PL.native-survival-rows, U106(1); core's P9c survival logic, P9c.core and PL.core-survival-rules) — each row's answer shape over core's functions, the state one row answers being the state the next row is sent (the needs and the HUD carry no session), core's refusals as VALUES, the rows' own refusals as errors coded [invalid-input], and the StaminaPool session: each op's fact delta and the host calls core made, a saved pool restored. Every expectation here was computed by core's own functions at the pin, not by these rows. Core's own corpora (conformance/survival/{needs,hud,stamina}.json, 89 cases) are driven whole through these rows by the survival_corpus ctest (tests/survival_corpus.cpp), not transcribed here.

cases.name: survival.needs: the state one row answers is the state the next row is sent; each answer is core's, whole
survival.needs: core's refusals are VALUES; a state, hud, item or events of the wrong JSON type is [invalid-input]

steps.expectError: [invalid-input] insimulcore: survival.needs.advance: `state` must be a JSON object
[invalid-input] insimulcore: survival.needs.save: `state` must be a JSON object
[invalid-input] insimulcore: survival.needs.useItem: `item` must be a JSON object
[invalid-input] insimulcore: survival.hud.reduce: `events` must be an array
[invalid-input] insimulcore: survival.hud.stamina: `stamina` must be a JSON object
[invalid-input] insimulcore: survival.hud.view: `hud` must be a JSON object
[invalid-input] insimulcore: survival.hud.systems: `catalog` must be a JSON object

cases.name: survival.hud: a new HUD, the needs' flashes, the stamina bar held with one rest tick of hysteresis, and the bars
survival.stamina: the tuning, the band, a spend, rest at the combat rate, and the rest clock
survival.stamina.pool: one session per playthrough; each op's fact delta and host calls; a saved pool restores

steps.expectError: [invalid-input] insimulcore: survival.stamina.pool.create: `actors[0]` must be a JSON object
